title: All armies
notes: What any army may use, whatever its Nexus: the faction-neutral bench buildings PERIMETER has always offered (the Hatchery and the Turret, with the swarmers the Hatchery breeds) and War Chest, the owner's testing tool. A faction's own units, buildings and Nexus powers are in its faction army (citizen, ravel), and a Commander's in hers. Costs are round numbers, not balance.

buildings.notes: Three swarmers in one wave a round: every building the player places that makes units spawns in waves, the same rule as the Barracks. Before, it bred one every few seconds, three alive at most (its own spawner, which a grid scenario's Hatchery still has).

powers.name: War Chest
powers.notes: The owner's tool for testing placement, not a real power: 2000, enough to place buildings freely. Offered beside every hand rather than dealt into one (his answer, 2026-10-07: 'Always in the hand').
